<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Macroeconomic pressures:</strong> The Indian rupee has weakened to 95.55 against the dollar, driven by rising crude oil prices and geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, while the RBI faces a policy dilemma balancing a Rs 11.3 lakh crore liquidity surplus against inflationary risks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNVnJsQTdLTFpWX0hNa25fVU84cVlKR3oyaUFRN3g1TWd0d3NzU2x2eWZra09Tckl4bTB4bHc3NmpJcEtLYTQwWm9wa1EweTFRdUpHcmVENHZNTWl2aHYyaDZSWkVuSW9tTDVQTk82d29jWTJhbDFDM3JRa19zRnNtck00S2NZeWRXQzRoakpJTVlhYzBVd2s1ZXhQdmdsaGVBdlRZaUxvMWRXeXVwb2EzVFhn?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>RBI policy outlook:</strong> Governor Sanjay Malhotra indicated that the MPC will reassess growth and inflation projections next month as crude oil shocks and rising inflation expectations keep the central bank in a hawkish stance.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Bond market movement:</strong> The 10-year government bond yield has crossed the 7% threshold following the RBI&#x27;s decision to trim auction bids, reflecting tighter liquidity management and shifting interest rate expectations.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Global inflation and Fed policy:</strong> US consumer prices accelerated in August, heightening expectations of a potential Federal Reserve rate hike and weighing on global market sentiment.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Energy and market impact:</strong> Surging crude oil prices near $110 have contributed to significant volatility in Indian equities, with markets reacting to the combined pressure of energy costs and rising US bond yields.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
</ul>
